**Coverage:** happens-before, atomics, locks, executors, cancellation, virtual threads, structured concurrency.

modelAnswer: Core: a Semaphore-bounded executor wrapper; submit returns a CompletableFuture preserving submission order via a completion-ordered queue or indexed futures.

Partial failure: a result type per task (success | failure | cancelled) — an aggregate API returning all outcomes, not first-exception.
Virtual-thread reasoning: bounded concurrency is still needed (the database didn't grow), but semaphore-per-task replaces pool sizing as the mechanism — state which resource is actually scarce.

Isolation: per-dependency concurrency caps and timeouts so one slow service cannot consume the fan-out's shared budget.
Retries: within-budget single retry on idempotent reads only; a fan-out retry doubles load exactly when the system is worst positioned to absorb it.

**Coverage:** class loading, JIT, GC, allocation, native memory, profiling, JFR.

**Coverage:** dependency injection, transactions, JPA, testing, modularity, failure semantics.

Idempotency: unique constraint on the client-supplied key; a duplicate request returns the stored outcome rather than double-charging.

title: Coding: secure token validation boundary
prompt: Build a Java token-validation component that checks issuer, audience, signature, time claims, key rotation, and explicit clock skew. Keep authorization policy outside the parser.

title: Coding: hostile URL fetcher
prompt: Harden a Java service that fetches user-supplied URLs. Address parsing ambiguity, DNS rebinding, private ranges, redirects, size limits, timeouts, and content handling.
artifact: Threat-focused code, adversarial tests, and residual-risk statement.

completion: State the primary invariant, one rejected alternative, the most dangerous failure mode, and how you would verify the result. Score the first attempt before consulting references.
modelAnswer: Parse with a hardened URL library, then validate EVERYTHING derived: scheme (http/https only), host resolves to public IPs only (block RFC1918, link-local, loopback, cloud metadata 169.254.169.254).

DNS rebinding: resolve the host and validate the IPs, then connect TO THE VALIDATED IP with the Host header — a second resolution at connect time can differ; pin the connection to the validated address.
Redirects: re-validate every hop (a safe URL can redirect to an internal one); cap redirect count and total response size; stream with a hard byte limit.
Timeouts and content handling: bounded fetch time, content-type allowlist, never execute or parse untrusted content server-side beyond the need; log the target for audit.
